blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Another member of the Islamic State-aligned Dawlah Islamiyah-Hassan Group (DI-HG) was killed, and two others were wounded in a clash with military and police forces during a law enforcement operation in Barangay Kuloy, Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur, on Thursday morning. Lt. Col. Loqui Marco, commanding officer of the 90th Infantry Battalion (IB), said the joint operation targeted Tahir Salik, alias “Joross Salik” or “Zubair,” and Samin Tagal, alias “Samin,” both alleged members of the DI-Hassan Group who are facing criminal charges for murder, frustrated murder, and robbery. Authorities issued arrest warrants against them in connection with these cases. […]... Keep on reading: Dawlah Islamiyah member killed in Maguindanao del Sur clash
